subbench.objective: An INSTRUMENT sentinel, not a survey: a small, FIXED set of short-call cells whose per-call time (tens of ns) is sensitive to the bench's OWN timing code, measured in EVERY window beside pcre2-jit as the flat control. [B133] (after [B132]): adding stamp getters to testees/pcrec/driver.c moved short calls +10-17% on program-identical cells, which looked like a pcrec regression for three weeks (O-92).
